title: Pure Centur-Ion
summary: Centur-Ion cards only, with generic staples; the page's Crimson Dragon finishers are left out, among them Hot Red Dragon Archfiend King Calamity, which is Forbidden in the TCG. Centur-Ion monsters sit in the Spell & Trap Zone as face-up Continuous Traps and summon themselves from there during either player's Main Phase, so the deck Synchro Summons on the opponent's turn. Centur-Ion Primera searches any Centur-Ion card, Trudea places itself and another Centur-Ion as Traps, and Stand Up Centur-Ion! and Emblema Oath place more from the Deck. The Level 12 Synchros Legatia and Auxila draw, search and destroy, and Centur-Ion True Awakening negates by sending one of the Trap monsters. The newest cards are the 2024 wave: Atrii draws, Chimerea rewrites an opposing monster effect, and Primera Primus searches an Emblema card and destroys a card on each field.
